insight: A Y Combinator W23 company whose three founders had been building on GPT-3 since March 2020, well before the LLMOps category existed.
name: Vellum
tagline: Build, evaluate, and deploy production LLM apps and agents.
description: An end-to-end development platform for building, testing, and shipping LLM applications and agents. Vellum pairs a visual drag-and-drop workflow builder with a Python SDK, and bundles prompt versioning, RAG, evaluation, and production monitoring in one place so technical and non-technical teammates can collaborate. Built-in eval and test suites let teams measure quality before and after deploy. A free tier is available; paid Pro and Enterprise plans add seats and scale.

modelSupport.notes: Connects to major model providers; token costs are passed through at cost.

edge: Pairs a visual workflow builder with a Python SDK and passes model token costs through at cost — collaboration-friendly LLMOps without markup.
